title: JD Sports, Pershing Square’s overhaul and Oxford Nanopore:Companies and Markets Show
summary: The FTSE 100 retailer has blamed much of the slump on delayed back-to-school spending and a rising cost of living. Next we turn to what has become a trend of the past few months: star fund managers overhauling portfolios. Bill Ackman of Pershing Square has joined the party in trying to stop disappointing returns, but when your portfolio only has around 12 stocks, and you change 11 of them, it’s going to have some significant repercussions.
